name: HcpSpeakerProgramManager
tagline: Compliant speaker programs from request to transparency report – in one Power Apps component.
description: Complete pharmaceutical speaker program app for Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages: plan programs, contract speakers within FMV rates and annual caps, run compliance review with lead time, meal and audience rules, record attendance and sign-in sheets, reconcile spend and report transfers of value. Works instantly in demo mode.
features: FMV rate per speaker tier and annual cap per speaker
Approval lead-time, meal cap and min/max audience rules
Approved deck and speaker training checks
Attendance with HCP vs non-HCP, sign-in sheet and repeat attendees
Reconciliation with meal cost per attendee and budget tolerance
Transfer-of-value lines, disclosure deadline and CSV export
Drag-and-drop pipeline with enforced stage rules
Bulk host, advance, report, cancel and export
Undo, history, read-only mode, phone layout
controlType: standard (2 controls: HcpSpeakerProgramManager data-set + HcpSpeakerProgramManagerPortal field control for Power Pages)
